Overall, this game is a quality Hidden Object game with very detailed art and lots of extras.

The story of the game is straight forward enough and it wasn't hard to follow or anything. You get small updates as you finish major sections or key events, but luckily for the most part you are left to explore and do puzzles on your own.

The art I found to be very high-quality, certainly newer looking than some other games with a more animated art style--which there is nothing wrong with the games, but if a game looks good like this I have to say it's still impressive. The cutscenes are also well animated and integrated into the static scenes very well.

Music was background music, fine to listen to but not very memorable.

The games I found to be mostly OK. There is a good amount of both Hidden Object puzzles and more traditional puzzles. I found some of these to be fairly difficult for different reasons. Not anything that kept me from finishing the game, but sometimes I would just call it a night and take a fresh look at the puzzle the next day.

The Hidden Object games had a strange design I hadn't seen before where when you find an object, the name is the bottom can be replaced with a new name. So essentially if there are 8 spaces, you would find 16 total items because each item would have an additional item under that first text. I get that this allows the game to have large readable text while still having a high number of objects to find. But when I first started playing I was just confused because I hadn't seen this done before and I thought it was a bug and the items I found were getting unmarked and reset instead. Otherwise, the scenes I found more difficult than most games because the swapping names made it hard to scan for multiple things at once and because of confusing names for certain objects. This game also has "sub-scenes" where you can look inside a chest for example to see another scene inside the Hidden Object scene with additional items in them. I'm familiar enough with this from other games, but some of the sub-scenes were not intuitive to find at all and also delayed finishing those puzzles. Usually at least once in a playthrough in most Hidden Object games I could finish one Hidden Object puzzle in 60 seconds or less (a common achievement in Hidden Object games, which this one also has), but in this game across both the main game and bonus adventure, I was never able to complete a single Hidden Object puzzle in that time. It might just be me, but I had to go back and start another playthrough and practice to get that achievement in this game. So, something to be aware of if you're looking for something more casual or find standard Hidden Object puzzles just challenging enough already.

The non-Hidden Object puzzles were fine and easy to understand with the exception of one that was so poorly designed I did have to look it up. Sadly the guide had no explanation for how it was solved, and it really bothers me when games have puzzles that cannot be solved with any kind of logic or intuition. It really didn't seem to have any clues or logic to it at all.

SPOILER TO SEE WHICH PUZZLE IT WAS: [spoiler] The puzzle that is outside near a temple entrance and bridge with 3 stone statues. You have to rotate sections of the statue to line up the correct sequence of patterns for each one. I didn't ever see anything that would have given you a meaningful clue to how the pattern was supposed to go. I don't know if this was supposed to be brute-forced or not, because every statue used the same patterns once found, but if so that's really a confusing and poor way to implement a puzzle. I would recommend just looking this puzzle up but the rest you can absolutely solve with the clues they give you. [/spoiler]


Most of the rest was fine, every so often you have the trope of an item seeming to have an illogical use that doesn't seem to make sense, and this game has at least one of those, but I didn't often get stuck for long unless it was on specific puzzles.

Those gripes aside, the game I still found to have a lot of content and not only be a solid, well-rounded game with great art, but also was a great value for what it's listen considering the length of the game. It also includes collectibles and a bonus adventure which helps make this a really positive recommendation for me.

This game does have a difficulty-related achievement so if you want to get all of the trophies in one playthrough then I would recommend you make sure to play on hard. (Although this game's hard mode still told you which locations had actions available so their hard is much more forgiving then most.)

Another important note, the difficulty achievement includes the bonus adventure as part of the game, even though most Hidden Object games with a difficulty achievement do not. In order to get the achievement for beating the game on hard, you will need to compete both the main game and bonus adventure on the hard difficulty on one profile.

I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.

Portal of Evil: Stolen Runes is a hidden object adventure game where you play as Vanessa, who inherits special powers like visions and dreams from her grandfather. You have to stop an ancient evil from breaking into the world. The whole thing starts when Archbishop Benedict invites you to Italy, and from there you explore different locations. Each area has a different visual style, some places are bright and dreamlike, others are a bit dark and creepy.

The hidden object scenes are pretty nice because there are actually two different types. The normal/classic ones have you finding items from a list, but the reverse scenes make you put objects back where they belong. I thought that was a nice change from the usual formula. There's a hint system if you get stuck, and they even include a full walkthrough for when you're really lost.

My only complaint is the ending since it felt really rushed and left too many things unexplained.

Gran aventura point and click de misterio (tradicional en este genero), estilo tomb rider/indiana jones, no obstante destaca muchísimo porque ademas de tener una Musica, sonidos, graficos y ambientacion excelentes, tiene Hermosas escenas cinematograficas, doblada en todos sus dialogos y subtitulada, en esencia lo que deberia ser en TODA aventura de este genero (este aspecto esta muy bien cuidado), independientemente de que quizas la historia tiene algunos puntos flojos (Algo de tu abuelo en una secta religiosa y al final es como que descubris algo pero no se termina de entender bien que onda). Mi gran critica es justamente que al no jugársela con una saga de juegos que tengan una historia en común (como las franquicias que mencione arriba) pierde calidad el juego, y toda gran franquicia siempre empieza asi, con un titulo chico que luego se va expandiendo para cada vez abarcar mas cosas. No digo necesariamente que este juego pueda ser el caso, pero seria genial que este tipo de estudios intentaran pensar de esta manera porque se pueden crear grandes cosas, en el caso de este titulo esta bastante bien en todos los otros aspectos salvo ese justamente.
Rescato como positivo que tiene sistema de Pistas y saltar puzzles (con un timer para que no nos tentemos de hacerlo instantáneo y podamos entrenar la mente antes de capaz trabarnos y pedir ayuda o el autocompletar). Tiene un Capitulo bonus que aporta algo mas de contenido a la historia pero bueno, es poco memorable como digo en ese aspecto.
No obstante todo lo dicho, debido a lo cuidado con el tema cinematográfico y los otros aspectos, la disfrute muchísimo mas que las típicas aventuras point and click de estudios como Big Fish, que son ultra genéricas y es mas que nada para entrenar algo la faceta detectivesca y nada mas.

《Portal of Evil: Stolen Runes Collector's Edition》在上线后，虽然吸引了一部分玩家的关注，但经过我的体验，这款游戏存在一些令人失望的地方。

首先游戏的故事情节显得相当平淡乏味。尽管游戏试图通过收集被盗符文来构建一个神秘的世界观，但整个剧情线索缺乏深度和吸引力。角色之间的对话和互动也显得单调，缺乏情感投入，使得玩家难以对游戏产生强烈的代入感。

其次游戏的关卡设计显得过于简单和重复。虽然游戏提供了多个关卡供玩家挑战，但这些关卡在布局和难度上缺乏变化，很容易让玩家感到厌倦。此外游戏中的谜题和敌人也缺乏创新和挑战性，使得整个游戏体验显得乏味和单调。

在音效方面，这款游戏同样存在一些问题。游戏的背景音乐和音效缺乏特色，无法为游戏营造出一种独特的氛围。有时候音效甚至会出现突兀和不协调的情况，破坏了游戏的整体体验。

此外游戏的操作体验也不尽如人意。尽管游戏在控制方面没有太大的问题，但一些细节处理不够到位，如角色的移动和攻击响应不够迅速，给玩家带来了一定的不便。这种操作上的不流畅感会影响玩家的游戏体验，尤其是在紧张刺激的战斗场景中。

最后游戏的画面表现也略显粗糙。虽然游戏在视觉效果上做出了一定的努力，但整体画面仍然显得不够细腻和精致。一些场景和角色的设计也显得过于简单和粗糙，无法给玩家带来足够的视觉享受。

综上所述，在故事情节、关卡设计、音效、操作体验和画面表现等方面都存在一些令人失望的问题。虽然这款游戏试图通过独特的玩法和收藏版内容来吸引玩家，但整体体验并不尽如人意。如果你对游戏的品质要求较高，或者期待一款深度和趣味性兼备的游戏，那么这款游戏可能不是你的最佳选择。

Surprisingly, this random hidden object adventure game I bought a year ago... is really good!  It has everything I want in this kind of game.

Even though the game is so old that it was made at a 4:3 aspect ratio, the quality is above average.  There are many FMVs to highlight important moments and though they're low resolution and blurry, they still look alright.

The game is packed with mini-games and hidden object scenes.  There are several worlds to visit and the game has a good length.  Backtracking is important, and fortunately there's a map with teleportation.  The map can also show areas with active interactions, even on expert mode, which is crucial because it's hard to remember every interaction that can't be completed until potentially hours later.

The game has a "bonus chapter," but the developers did something very strange here.  The main game abruptly ends without resolving the conflict.  The "bonus chapter" is actually the game's ending and not a separate story, like in most HOAGs that include a bonus.

The bonus chapter [i]also[/i] ends without resolving the conflict and promises we'll get him next time.  We're almost eight years later, and the Portal of Evil franchise is still just one game.  I guess the bad guy got away with it?

Anyways, this is one of my favorite HOAGs I've played and it shows that these one-off standalone games can be enjoyable.

[h1]●ゲームの説明[/h1]

　とある宗教団体の関係者であるエイブラハム・ヴァン・ヘルシングを祖父に持つバネッサ。ある日彼女は悪夢に魘され目覚めた。
　その後、玄関に向かうとベネディクト大司教という人物からの手紙を発見する。手紙には大至急の用件があり来て欲しいという主旨の内容が書かれており、祖父にも関係があるらしい。元々祖父に興味のあった彼女は手紙に指定されたイタリアの聖ペトロ大聖堂へと向かう。

　この架空の大聖堂を舞台としたファンタジー要素のある探索＋謎解きのポイント＆クリックゲーム。


■ゲームの要素
▼2つの難易度がある。カジュアルはヒントのチャージが30秒以内でアクティブ出来る場所が煌めく。エキスパートはヒントのチャージが1分以内でアクティブ出来る場所は煌めかないという物。

▼ヒントをクリックすると、次に必要なアイテムや場所を強調する。

▼謎解きは解けない場合にスキップ可能だが、実績は取れなくなる。

▼ウォーリーを探せて的なミニゲームが特徴的かつ多く登場する。画面下にリストされたアイテムを一枚絵の様な画面から探し出す。

▼一つ上の項目に似たミニゲームも特徴的で、こちらも多く登場する。こちらは画面下にあるアイテムを適切な場所に配置する。ちなみに両者は同じ一枚絵を扱うので、一枚絵の変化が楽しめる。

▼マップで瞬間移動……ファストトラベル……が可能。またアクションを起こせる場所をオレンジで強調してくれる。

▼日本語あり。クリア時間は5～7時間ぐらい。

▼ムービーシーンが多く、会話シーン等はムービーで進行する。



[h1]●良い点[/h1]

[b]・詰みにくい[/b]
　マップで次に行く必要のある場所が常に分かるので、ヒント機能なしでもクリアし易く、あちこちを虱潰しにする必要がない。かといって露骨に簡単すぎる訳でもないので、しっかりと探索や謎解きを楽しめる。


[b]・日本語訳が優秀[/b]
　Steamにあるこの手のジャンルは日本語が酷いらしいが、このゲームは特にそのように思う箇所はない。一つだけ誤字・脱字の類を発見したが、そのシーンでも注意深く見てないと気が付かないくらいだったので、安心してプレイ出来る。


[b]・ストーリー[/b]
　段々と謎が明らかになっていくストーリー。そしてムービーによる重厚感のある演出は、謎解きゲームの中では優秀な方だと感じさせられた。突飛な展開は少ないが、矛盾もなく纏まった話なので良い。


[b]・問題のある個所が分かり易い[/b]
　マウスを移動してアクセス可能なポイントに重なればアイコンが変化し、クリックすればバネッサのそのポイントへの感想やヒントが聞けるので参考にし易い。


[b]・記憶力はあまり要らない[/b]
　過去に見た資料等はほぼ何時でも見られるので、暗号等をその場所まで見に行ったり、メモ帳等に記載する必要が無い。



[h1]●微妙な点[/h1]

[b]・謎解きが簡単過ぎるかもしれない[/b]
　ヒントが良く与えられ、あまり悩み過ぎる必要が無いのは良い。しかし感覚的にクリア出来る問題が些か多い気がするので、少し拍子抜けかも知れない。
　予想や推理して紐解く類の問題のやや不足しているかもしれない。



[h1]●悪い点[/h1]

[b]・クリックのし過ぎで誤作動しやすい[/b]
　複数以上のクリックを繰り返すと、遅れて反応する為なのかマウス移動するだけでアイコンを選択してしまう事が多い。このせいでヒント縛り等をしている時に誤って操作してしまうかもしれない。少し待ったり、問題の無い選択ポイントにマウスを合わせればその内直る。なのでそこまで問題ではないが気を付けて欲しい。


[b]・ミニゲーム[/b]
　前述したウォーリーを探せ的な物探しのミニゲームがある。これは暗い場所等の分かり難い場所に在ったり、一度クリックして物を退かさないと発見出来ない事があるので、クリック連打の総当たり的遊び方になってしまい易い。また退かして物を探し当てるという行為は、こういった物探しゲームとしての趣を否定している様で少しいい加減なような気がする。
　他にもマウスドラックで物を退かすミニゲームもあり、操作が大変だったりする。なので少し面倒くさい様に感じるかもしれない。



[h1]●お薦めな点・感想等[/h1]
　人によっては悪いと思う所もそれなりにはあるが、全体的には良く纏まったゲームだと思う。便利な機能も充実しているのでストレスに感じる事はほぼない。ストーリーも絶賛する程ではないにしても良作と言える範囲だと思えお薦めし易い。

　ただ注意点として、見えにくい場所やマウスで選択できる範囲の狭いアイテムがあって、見逃し易いのが玉に瑕かもしれない。

　また推理等の思考力を要求する問題が少なめなので、難しい方が燃えるのであればやや物足りないかもしれない。

　そういった所が問題でなければ割と楽しめるゲームだ。
